title: Market
description: Reusable competitor/ranking intelligence for one niche+city, at data/markets/<market_id>/market.json. Populated at discovery time from WebSearch and expanded by scripts/enrich_market.py from imported ranking data (config/routing.yaml's paid specialists are never required to build this). Reused across every lead in the same market -- never rediscover the same top-3 competitors per company.

top_organic_competitors.description: Domains/names ranked #1-3 organic for the market's primary money keyword, per the latest ranking import

top_maps_competitors.description: Names ranked #1-3 in the local pack for the market's primary money keyword, per the latest ranking import

ranking_urls.description: Specific competitor page URLs observed ranking, useful as dossier evidence sources

search_volume.description: keyword -> monthly search volume, from ranking imports

kd.description: keyword -> keyword difficulty, from ranking imports

source.description: e.g. websearch, semrush_csv, manual_csv -- set/updated by scripts/enrich_market.py when ranking data is imported
